record.question: What is meant by the legal expression "technical assault"?
options: It describes undue trauma or excessive discomfort
It is an assault upon a patient in any form other than physical eg verbal or emotional
It the act of touching a person without his consent
It is the process of treating a patient using complex or technical armamentarium rather than using a part of the human body such as a finger.
